activities.name: Merge
activities.whenToUse: Use when ItemSignal contains Base and Overlay under %.@ for structured JSON overlay merging. The branch reads Plan settings with defaults, passes them to Invoke-MergeJson and returns its merged Result on success.

properties.whenToUse: Set the JSON serialization/parsing depth when the default 20 is insufficient for the Base/Overlay structure. The Merge branch forwards this resolved value to Invoke-MergeJson.
Choose the array merge behavior to forward to Invoke-MergeJson. Omit to use the Merge branch's default Merge; this explicit forwarding overrides the helper's separate Replace parameter default.

properties.description: Choose how null overlay values are handled.
properties.whenToUse: Choose how null overlay values are handled by the JSON merge helper. Omit to use Ignore in the Merge branch.

result.description: When Base and Overlay resolve; merge options valid; Invoke-MergeJson succeeds.
